purpose: Bind the already-built normalized EE-P2X receipt/verifier packet to the exact adopted reducer and qualified Darwin driver interface without redesigning either.

backend_measured_payload_bridge.shape: mapping from normalized evidence role to repository-relative path
backend_measured_payload_bridge.binding_law: Every declared repository-relative evidence artifact must also appear in the same terminal ledger entry output_artifact_hashes as repo:<path> with exact SHA-256.

driver_specific_failure_extension.law: The driver-bound verifier returns the normalized failure receipt disposition directly and does not force this driver-only court-wide authority blocker through the older normalized verifier vocabulary.

supervisor_tokens.file_rule: replace '/' in stage address with '__' and append '.json'
supervisor_tokens.required_for: every actually executed backend-envelope stage whose reducer tuple has physical_host_measurement_required=true
supervisor_tokens.historical_ledger_hash_law: ledger_sha256 is the exact point-in-time post-stage ledger hash emitted by the driver; it is not replaced by the final ledger hash.

preservation_laws: DONE__PRESERVE is never accepted with a backend execution envelope.
SKIP__NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_FROZEN_LAW is never accepted with a backend execution envelope.
LiTS-A qualifying first build and LiTS-B standalone cacheless C11 remain repetition-forbidden.
WVS7/C S01 is accepted only as the driver's preserved candidate-local portability failure and all later WVS7/C stages remain mechanical frozen-law skips.
Candidate-local/common-source propagation receipts are non-execution terminalization and must point backward to an actual typed blocker stage.
No source/candidate result is inferred from absence of a receipt.

final_verification_law.precondition: All S00-S16 reducer stages must be terminal and hash-revalidated by the driver-bound verifier.
final_verification_law.common_court_short_circuit: If a backend envelope terminalizes as COMMON_COURT_BLOCKER, return the exact normalized failure disposition after validating its driver binding; do not manufacture later-cell evidence.
final_verification_law.normalized_verification: Otherwise synchronize the normalized court manifest from driver evidence bindings, then run the existing normalized verifier unchanged.
final_verification_law.post_run: After driver run/resume returns, execute driver --verify-only and retain its exact PASS output alongside normalized final verification.
